description: The data of a task.announced on node_review, which the Network Monitor announces in the trace it opens for the review and the Spawner of target_topic's partition claims (architecture §3.12.3, implementation §10.1). The common fields are in data.schema.json.

node_id.description: The node under review, by its platform identity (architecture §3.12.3).

target_topic.description: The topic of the node's specialty, which routes the review to its partition (architecture §3.7.7).

n_observations.description: The closes in the node's quality window (architecture §3.12.1).

trigger_reason.description: What the review asserts about the node, which decides the Spawner's rule (architecture §3.12.3).

signals.description: The node's full signal vector, with the shape of signals.vector.schema.json, which the validator applies to it (architecture §3.12.2, implementation §10.1).

reopens_by_requester.description: The node's reopens in the quality window, grouped by the platform identity of the requester that reopened: diagnostic, with no weight and no trigger (architecture §3.12.3).

reopens.description: How many of the window's closes it reopened.
